messages:
Alex: Quick sync — we need final decisions on which runtime metrics infra will emit so Console can build per-route SLO panels (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec).
Maya: Agree. Minimal set: latency histogram, ttft (ms), tokens_generated, tokens_received, request_count. Add model, route, variant, region labels.
TJ: Question: do we emit quantiles from runtime or store raw histograms and compute in the query layer? Runtime quantiles are cheap to store but opaque for re-aggregation.
Sofia: Strong 👍 for raw histograms (exponential buckets) + sum/count. Query-time quantiles give us flexibility for per-route & sliding-window SLOs.
Samir: Warning — histograms at 1k+ qps per model will blow up cardinality. We should default to sampling (1%) for high-traffic routes and provide a way to opt into full telemetry.
Alex: Also Console wants TTFT defined as first-byte - request-start. Can we emit ttft_ms gauge per request? That avoids deducing from spans.
Maya: Example metric contract to discuss:
```
runtime.request_latency_bucket{model="gptx-3",route="/chat",variant="v1",le="0.1",region="us-west-2"}
runtime.request_latency_sum{model="gptx-3",route="/chat",variant="v1",region="us-west-2"}
runtime.request_latency_count{...}
runtime.ttft_ms{model="gptx-3",route="/chat",variant="v1",region="us-west-2"}  # gauge per request
runtime.tokens_generated_total{model="gptx-3",route="/chat",variant="v1"}
runtime.telemetry_sample{model="gptx-3",route="/chat",sampling="0.01"}
```
TJ: We should surface tokens/sec as a derived rate from tokens_generated_total (promql: rate(tokens_generated_total[1m])) rather than a dedicated gauge. Less overhead.
Sofia: Console panels we need: TTFT P50/P95/P99, TTFT trend, tokens/sec, requests/sec, latency distribution heatmap, token-per-request scatter (sampled). Also ability to pivot by region/variant/tenant_tier.
Samir: For quotas: infra will cap telemetry ingestion at ~10k datapoints/sec per tenant in hosted. For customers hitting cap we fallback to sample-mode and surface a note in Console. Enterprise can purchase 'full telemetry'.
Alex: @observability-bot any blockers on schema validation or ingest contracts?
observability-bot: Schema PR #432 merged to staging. Required labels: model, route, variant, region, tenant_tier. Buckets: exp 0.5ms->32s (configured). See https://go/obs-schema-432 for details.
Maya: We need to decide default sampling rates and an escape hatch (emit_full_telemetry per-tenant flag). Also confirm how canaries/rollouts will surface missing metrics.
TJ: I'll open an API/config PR to add runtime flags: emit_histogram=true|false, sampling_rate=0.01, emit_ttft=true. Will tag @eng-runtime and @eng-sre.
Sofia: :thumbsup: Console team will prototype panels in branch `console/route-slo-proto` and link screenshots here when ready. We want mock trades: aggregated quantiles vs query-derived.
deploy-bot: deployed: telemetry-schema-v2 to staging (sha:abc123). Staging stream includes sampling=0.01 for noisy routes.
Alex: Next steps: TJ to open PR this afternoon, Maya/Samir confirm bucket boundaries and sampling defaults by EOD Tue, Sofia will add dashboard mocks by Wed EOD. Thanks all.
